# Heavy work off the UI: a task-worker job with its progress on the page

## Context

`examples/worker/task` is the engine's only example with a task worker. It has no catalog record, so Workers & Platform does not show it; the folder was last changed in July 2025. #21140's target renews it as "Heavy work off the UI", and the band's epic #21358 counts it among its nine renewals. No leaf was filed.

## The Problem

The band's read ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980292611)): "One button on a white page; the answer goes to the console." A visitor asks "does the UI stay alive under heavy work?" and gets a button whose result they cannot see.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/worker/Task.mjs`: the task worker, a thread for work that belongs neither to the app worker nor to the main thread.
- `examples/worker/task`: the folder to rebuild in place.
- No record with this folder exists in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` on `dev` `78013b10fc`.

## The Fix

Rebuild the example in place. A job that takes seconds runs in the task worker and reports its progress to the page. While it runs, a text field stays editable. A switch runs the same job in the app worker instead, and the page shows the difference: the field or a small frame counter stalls. One line on screen says what to try. It gets its record in Workers & Platform.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The job's progress and its result show on the page; nothing the visitor needs is in the console.
- [ ] While the job runs in the task worker, typing into the field keeps working; with the switch on the app worker, the stall is visible on the page.
- [ ] One line on the first frame names the action.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme its sibling examples offer.
- [ ] A record in Workers & Platform with a caption in the visitor's words and a cover from its first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame and the frame mid-job, both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

A new worker type or a change to `src/worker/Task.mjs` beyond a defect the drive finds (that is its own ticket). The canvas example.

## Avoided Traps

- **A spinner instead of a comparison.** The proof is the difference between the two workers, so both runs must be one switch apart.
